pages.text: Evolving takes everything. The camp, the tools, the band, the body - all of it stays in the deep past, and your descendants wake a long way off with nothing.$(br2)One thing crosses: a name.

When you go, whoever you were closest to - your mate, or whoever thought most of you - is remembered.$(br2)Somebody in the band that wakes around your descendants is called after them, and starts out thinking a little more of you than the rest do.

They do not know who the name belonged to. It is only a name their people use, and nobody alive has ever met its owner.$(br2)Your journal keeps the line of them - one from every band you have left behind. It is the oldest thing anyone has ever inherited.
